name: Kuroda Group Co.,Ltd.
summary: Kuroda Group Co., Ltd. engages in manufacturing and sales of oriented film printing plates. Its products are used in liquid crystal displays, automation equipment, plastic injection molds, parts for HDD, electrical facilities materials and power materials, and aluminum die-cast products, design and contract development of printed circuit boards, sales of electronic parts and electrical materials to the electronics and automotive industries. The company was founded on October 06, 2017 and is headquartered in Tokyo, Japan.
